The arm set $\X$ is a bounded closed (and hence compact) subset of $\mathbb{R}^d$ such that $\|x\| \leq 1$ ... There exists $S$ such that $\|\theta^\star\| \leq S$ and $S$ is known ... conditionally $R$-subgaussian

The link function $\mu$ is continuously differentiable, Lipschitz with constant $k_\mu$ and such that $c_\mu = \inf (x^\transp \theta) > 0$.

source.label: th:regret_ts
source.quote: Under assumptions~\ref{asm:arm.set},\ref{asm:param.set},\ref{asm:subgaussian}, the regret of \ts is bounded w.p. $1-\delta$ as ($\delta^\prime = \frac{\delta}{4T}$) R(T) \leq \big(\beta_T(\delta^\prime) +  \gamma_T(\delta^\prime)(1 + \frac{4}{p}) \big) \sqrt{ 2 T d \log \big( 1 + \frac{T}{\lambda} \big) } + \frac{4 \gamma_T(\delta^\prime)}{p} \sqrt{\frac{8 T } {\lambda} \log \frac{4}{\delta} }.

results.notes: Paper states this is of order O~(d^{3/2} sqrt(T)). Regret defined via means (pseudo-regret realized along trajectory), bound holds w.p. 1-delta. The paper's R is sigma.

source.label: p:generalized_regret
source.quote: Under assumptions~\ref{asm:arm.set},\ref{asm:param.set},\ref{asm:subgaussian} and~\ref{asm:link.function}, the cumulative regret of \ts over $T$ steps is bounded as R^{\text{GLM}}(T) \leq \frac{k_\mu}{c_\mu} \big(\beta_T(\delta^\prime) +  \gamma_T(\delta^\prime)(1 + 2/p) \big) \sqrt{ 2 T d \log \big( 1 + \frac{T}{\lambda} \big) } + \frac{2 k_\mu\gamma_T(\delta^\prime)}{p c_\mu} \sqrt{\frac{8 T } {\lambda} \log \frac{4}{\delta} } with probability $1-\delta$ where $\delta^\prime = \frac{\delta}{4T}$.

results.notes: Proof only sketched; constants (2/p vs 4/p) differ from Theorem 1 as printed. Regularized linear optimization extension claims the same bound as Theorem 1 informally (no formal statement), not recorded.
